newsitem.title: USA: Buba's Schieber - Forex must be watched carefully.
newsitem.headline: Buba's Schieber - Forex must be watched carefully.

text.p: Bundesbank directorate member Helmut Schieber said on Tuesday that foreign exchange rates must be watched carefully.
"We must keep foreign exchange rates in sight," Schieber told reporters before a round table discussion on financial and monetary affairs sponsored by the European Institute.
When asked about the dollar's current level, Schieber said: "I believe the G7 said the necessary things in Berlin and Washington," he added.
Bundesbank President Hans Tietmeyer said at the weekend G7 meeting that the United States would like a strong dollar, but not a stronger dollar.
The dollar has appreciated some 12 percent against the German mark since the beginning of the year.
Schieber declined to comment whether Germany might be considering any sort of currency market intervention.
"Of course you know I couldn't tell you that, even if we were thinking about it," he said.
More generally, Schieber said central banks need to be extraordinarily careful with interventions, adding that timing of interventions is always key.
